report.description: The full Markdown report required by review-followup, including Needs your attention.

needs_attention.description: True when required human actions, unresolved potential blockers, or unavailable required checks remain. After applying, also true if any accepted finding remains unfixed or unverified. During assessment, merely having accepted fixes to apply does not require attention.

accepted_findings.description: Number of findings accepted in this round, including nits. Keep the count after applying fixes; it counts accepted findings, not remaining defects.
